description: Terminal worker contract for trial t-031. Attenuated from K-E5-trial and bounded by K-E5-child-max on every axis. The child implements a wire-format encoder strictly from a supplied specification and returns it; it has no creation, delegation, or realization authority and no descendants.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
The child is terminal: it may not create, delegate, or launch anything.
